d: Classic American muscle car styling meets custom chopper craftsmanship in this special American Chopper build. Paul Jr. brings bold automotive design cues into the Make-A-Wish motorcycle, adding muscular fender lines, exposed air intakes, dual exhausts, and distinctive star-shaped details. As the OCC crew tackles tricky fitment and final assembly, Paul Sr. makes sure the bike is ready for its big moment. The finished muscle-inspired machine is finally unveiled to the Wish kids and their families, creating a celebration that goes far beyond motorcycle building. Watch American Chopper Season…
